scholarships.title: POSCO TJ Park Foundation Global Scholarship

existing.description: The POSCO Global Scholarship in Korea is the inbound component of the POSCO Global Scholarship operated by the POSCO TJ Park Foundation, and it is described by the Foundation as 'The Global Future Leaders Scholarship Program'. It funds non-Korean nationals admitted to Master's or doctoral programmes at designated Korean graduate schools, who must be recommended by their admitting institution. Master's students receive full tuition for four semesters plus living expenses of KRW 1,000,000 per month for 22 months, while doctoral and integrated master's-doctoral students receive full tuition for six semesters plus the same monthly living allowance for 36 months. A one-off KRW 1,000,000 settlement fee, National Health Insurance premiums and Korean language and cultural programmes are also provided.
eligibility: Holds or is expected to hold a Bachelor's degree
Non-Korean nationality; Korean citizens including dual citizenship holders are not eligible
Admitted to a Master's or Doctoral programme at a Korean graduate school
Recommended by the admitting graduate school
Eligible applicant country as listed in the Foundation FAQ
Enrolled at a designated eligible university
existing.eligibility_summary: Asian nationals planning to enroll in Master's or Doctoral programs at Korean universities; academic excellence; not previously received a Korean government scholarship.
benefits: Tuition fees; living expenses; arrival allowance; language excellence scholarships (specific amounts vary by sub-program)
coverage: Tuition fees; living expenses; arrival allowance; language excellence scholarships (specific amounts vary by sub-program)
application_method: Online via POSCO TJ Park Foundation website
existing.best_fit: Asian students seeking Master's or Doctoral funding at Korean universities.
existing.notes: ~50 students selected annually; all academic fields except MBA; specifically for Asian students.
existing.duration: Master's: 4 semesters of tuition support and 22 months of living expenses. Doctoral or integrated master's and doctoral: 6 semesters of tuition support and 36 months of living expenses.
existing.application_period: Annual cycle running from Korean graduate school admission in about November to the certificate award ceremony in March; candidates enter by being admitted to and being recommended by a Korean graduate school.
existing.program_type: Private-sector foundation scholarship (POSCO Group) administered by the POSCO TJ Park Foundation

scholarships.title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) Non-degree Exchange Program
scholarships.official_source: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), South Korea

existing.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate or graduate students of foreign nationality enrolled in an overseas university with an agreement with a Korean university affiliated with NIIED; overall academic performance 80% or above; not previously received a Korean government scholarship; not Korean nationals.
documents: Proof of enrollment at home university
application_method: Apply through NIIED-affiliated Korean universities (not individual application)
existing.best_fit: Exchange students from partner universities seeking short-term study funding in South Korea.
existing.notes: Distinct from GKS Degree Program (which is for full degree-seeking students). Duration: typically 4 months (1 semester). Students must return to home institution after exchange.
